description: Real CDP PNG/JPEG80 screencast frames at native1280x720; offline codec candidate processing, not production Eya transport or WAN. Node zlib raw DEFLATE level1; browser fflate inflateSync. Every tile candidate reconstructs exact captured PNG RGBA in Node and browser. EYT1 payload8byte header+7byte tile records; estimated wire includes JSON metadata+Noise/chunk framing, excludes WebSocket/TCP/IP/ACK. Unchanged updates omitted. Capture timing includes stop/start behavior and is not steady-state FPS. Decoder timings include copying the reference but exclude base64/test bridge and transfer. Canonical tile keyframe establishment is measured separately. Full PNG decode timing includes getImageData. JPEG differences are from separate same-state capture and are whole-image, not a legibility score.
